system.summary: Number codes, mostly 0 to 21, and two letter-like signs for letters, with a dot after each code and spaces between groups; codes of two to four digits for words, names and some letters; five letters write the same codes with no dots.
system.sibling_key: The Gualterio cipher tables (British Library, Add MS 20244), named by this ledger for entry 295; not opened. Two key files of targets/bay1706 hold the name Bottigor or Bottiger, not Botti; they are not about these letters.
system.notes: distinct_symbols counts the codes of key-and-read/key.tsv. homophones: i has the codes 0, a, u, 00 and 01; u has 1a, 1u and 18; e has 21 and 71; code 17 (r or q) is not counted. nomenclator.entries counts the word codes with a value (all from the clerk's decipherment); outcome.codes_open counts the codes with no value. Five letters write the codes with no dots; a letter model chose their cut.

prior_solution.where: Decipherments of the time above the cipher rows of 29 letters with dots, and a few words on R8618 (DECODE: inline plaintext on 30 records). The Gualterio cipher tables, British Library, Add MS 20244 (not opened).

conditions.human_role: I built the pipeline and the method, set the goals, chose the records and approved each publication. Language models ran the transcription passes, the fits, the decode and the checks inside that pipeline.
models: language models, not named at the contributor's request

solution.what: A transcription of the DECODE images of the 51 records: two readings of each page and a reconciliation; 191 pages with cipher digits, 2,568 rows.

A planted key on period Italian in the exact layout of the 46 letters with dots: 99.2% of the clean letter tokens read right on the held-out text, no wrong letter shown, no word code (check.md, section 2).
A key from the ciphertext alone on the 46 letters with dots, fixed at 11:27 (UTC-5): 97.0% of 25,760 code tokens shown (key-and-read/README.md).

The blind decode graded once against the clerk's decipherment above the cipher rows of 29 letters: 75.3% of 14,279 shown letters match; a wrong row gives 29.6% (check.md, section 1). A letter-match share, not a read share.
The same method with two letter-like signs as codes, fixed at 12:13 (UTC-5); not blind on the 29 graded letters: 98.1% of 27,432 code tokens shown; 75.0% of 15,460 shown letters match the clerk.
14 code values read off the clerk's decipherment: 9 words and names and 5 letter values (key-and-read/key.tsv).
R8618 with the key of the letters with dots, one code for each space item: it did not pass the declared check.

The key of the letters with dots on the five letters without dots, with a letter model choosing only the cut: 19 of 22 tested pages beat 20 wrong keys, 3 shuffled copies, Latin and Spanish (check.md, section 4).
Values for 15 two-digit codes missing from the key, each tested against shuffled copies and two halves of the letters: none passed, so no value was added.
R8468 T003 and T007 with the same key: both pass the key test; on T007 five sign values are not sure; T003 is a fragment. R8618 T002 passes no route.

DECODE's public record pages (status N/A, cipher type Unknown on all 51) and this ledger's catalogue (entry 295, readable with keys in hand: the Gualterio cipher tables, Add MS 20244). The tables were not opened. Print was not searched.

texts.label: R8468, 1710
texts.summary: Botti had fever and a bad headache, so he could not write, and he asks pardon. Ferrara is ill. Ruffo said that he would give Botti time until he was well. Then he ordered the lieutenant to serve Botti another injunction ("precetto"). Botti says that he is wronged, and he thinks of leaving. He names the Abbate, a count, and a return from Florence. (A guess from the decode; it is no reading.)
texts.note: 7 of 8 pages with cipher rows decoded; 3,088 code tokens, 2,996 with a value, 92 open, 0 items that are not codes. No reading; no word count (NOTES.md, 'Why no word count').

texts.label: R8469, 1710
texts.summary: Botti and the provincial treasurer, Conti, dispute who gives way to whom in the street ("il dritto della strada"). The delegate promised Botti precedence over all in the province. Botti says that precedence is not the same as taking the road from someone. Ruffo broke his word to the delegate, and Botti had to present a memorial in terms that shamed him. Conti says that he settled with Botti only as a private person, not as treasurer. Botti asks the cardinal to support him with Monsignore, in case the vice-legate cannot settle the matter. (A guess from the decode; it is no reading.)
texts.note: 5 of 8 pages with cipher rows decoded; 3,197 code tokens, 3,173 with a value, 24 open, 0 items that are not codes. No reading; no word count (NOTES.md, 'Why no word count').

texts.label: R8470, 1710
texts.summary: Botti writes letter after letter, then goes in person. The Abbate refuses to see him and makes a noise about it. There is talk of prison. Farsetti went to Cesena on the Abbate's order. A man complains that he was betrayed and deceived, and asks to be set free. Botti blames "the malice of the lieutenant". (A guess from the decode; it is no reading.)
texts.note: 4 of 5 pages with cipher rows decoded; 1,145 code tokens, 1,066 with a value, 79 open, 0 items that are not codes. No reading; no word count (NOTES.md, 'Why no word count').

texts.label: R8617, 1710
texts.summary: A quarrel at Bertinoro involves don Antonio, nephew of Ruffo. Monsignor Farsetti has neither the favour nor the esteem of Ruffo. After the midday meal, Ruffo goes away to write. Don Antonio comes out of Ruffo's room in good humour, claps his hands, and gives Botti's signed memorial to the delegate. (A guess from the decode; it is no reading.)
texts.note: 3 of 4 pages with cipher rows decoded; 1,388 code tokens, 1,384 with a value, 4 open, 0 items that are not codes. No reading; no word count (NOTES.md, 'Why no word count').

outcome.notes: Contributed by prabal-rje as a pull request. The status, the class and the reading review are for the maintainer. documents[].length.tokens: for the letters with dots, the code tokens on all their pages in the frozen decode (code groups); for the letters without dots, the digits of the rows (symbols), because their cut is not sure. Not measured with docs/_check_profile.py. No word count is given: no reading divides the decode into words (NOTES.md, "Why no word count"). The clerk's decipherments are not copied. The decode of the letters with dots shows the 14 values from the clerk as open; the decode of the letters without dots uses them (key-and-read/README.md). first_break is left out: the clerk wrote decipherments on 29 letters at the time, and a few words on R8618; print was not searched. The British Library's catalogue gives the volume to two writers, the Abbate Carlo Camillo Botti and his uncle the Abbate Lazaro Botti; which letters each wrote is not known.
